title: Chess
description: A paper theatre lit from the side. Play the computer, a friend, or a quick mate-in-one.
sources: Lichess puzzle database, https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles. Database exports are released under the Creative Commons CC0 license. The 45 puzzle IDs, FENs and UCI lines are exactly the set recorded in spec.md.
Lichess/chess-puzzles, https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lichess/chess-puzzles. Licence at source: CC0 1.0. The spec's selection query used this official mirror.
FIDE Laws of Chess, https://handbook.fide.com/chapter/E012023. Classic game rules, with original game wording. Automatic threefold and fifty-move draws follow the Recess spec.
Illustrations generated with OpenAI gpt-image, edited for Curio Class
Original engine, evaluation tables implementation, user interface and synthesized sound made for this game. Stockfish 19, GPL v3, is a development calibration tool only and is not included.
